name: mmeet_add_participants
description: Invite more people to an existing meeting (`slug`). Adds the participants and (by default) emails the new ones their join link + .ics. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Resolve names to emails via mcon_search first. Confirm the additions with the user before calling (it emails real people). Returns the updated meeting with its full participant list.

slug.description: Meeting slug to add people to.

participants.description: People to invite (emails; resolve names via mcon_search first).

notify.description: Email the newly added people (default true).
